title: Boundedly Rational Meta-Learning in Sequential Consumer Choice
abstract: arXiv:2605.16532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many consumer decisions involve repeated choices under uncertainty, where experience in one context may inform decisions in another. For example, experience with a brand in one market or usage context may shape beliefs about that brand in a new context. We study whether such cross-context transfer takes the form of meta-learning, in which experience across contexts updates higher-order beliefs that guide learning in a new context. In a hierarchical laboratory task, participants choose among airlines across routes and observe noisy binary outcomes. Participants improve both within and across routes, indicating cross-route knowledge transfer. We compare human choices with no-transfer, fully integrated meta-learning, and boundedly rational meta dynamic programming policies, BRMDP(D), where D is the number of hyper-posterior draws used to approximate integration. translated_title: 序列消费者选择中的有界理性元学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2605.16532v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：许多消费者决策涉及在不确定性下的重复选择，其中一个情境中的经验可能为另一个情境中的决策提供信息。例如，在一个市场或使用情境中对某个品牌的体验可能会塑造对新情境中该品牌的信念。我们研究了这种跨情境转移是否采取元学习的形式，即跨情境的经验更新指导新情境中学习的高阶信念。在一个分层实验室任务中，参与者在不同航线间选择航空公司，并观察带噪声的二元结果。参与者在航线内和跨航线都表现出改进，表明存在跨航线的知识转移。我们将人类选择与无转移、完全整合的元学习以及有界理性元动态规划策略（BRMDP(D)）进行比较，其中D是用于近似整合的超后验抽取次数。逐试验的似然比较显示，低D策略，特别是...
tldr: 本研究通过分层实验证明消费者在跨情境选择中展现元学习能力，且低复杂度有界理性策略能更准确地模拟人类行为。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through hierarchical experiments that consumers exhibit meta-learning in cross-context choices, and low-complexity bounded rationality policies more accurately model human behavior.
